definitions.explanation: An opening in a wall for light and air.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。

examples.english: To look outside through the window.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}めて→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}っている→降る：00839_furu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{窓|まど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}めた→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧。
examples.english: It was raining, so I closed the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦{起|お}きたら→起きる：00521_okiru⟧、まず{窓|まど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れます→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: When I wake up in the morning, I first open the window to let in fresh air.

notes:
{窓|まど} refers to windows—openings in walls for light, air, and viewing.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {窓|まど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open a window
- {窓|まど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧: to close a window
- {窓|まど}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look out the window
- {窓|まど}⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧: window glass/pane

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧: service counter, point of contact
- ⟦{窓側|まどがわ}→窓側：19397_madogawa⟧: window side (seats on trains)
- ⟦{窓辺|まどべ}→窓辺：20444_madobe⟧: by the window
- ⟦{出窓|でまど}→出窓：07067_demado⟧: bay window
- ⟦{窓枠|まどわく}→窓枠：15667_madowaku⟧: window frame

USAGE:
⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧ is commonly used figuratively to mean "point of contact" or "service counter" (e.g., ⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧ = consultation desk).
